titulo: A2 review and mock test (part 1): The most common mistakes of the first half of A2

aula.objetivo: Review the Perfekt, the Präteritum, the dative, the accusative and the prepositions of place on one map, practice reading, listening and writing in the format of A2 exams, fix the most common mistakes, and take an original practice test.

sessao.titulo: The most common mistakes of the first half of A2

blocos.explicacao: Read each pair out loud: first the wrong one (so you recognize how strange it sounds), then the right one.

erros.motivo: The participle goes to the end.
The person who likes goes into the dative.

erros.errado: Ich gebe den Mann das Buch.
erros.certo: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch.

erros.errado: Ich wohne seit drei Jahre hier.
erros.certo: Ich wohne seit drei Jahren hier.

erros.errado: Das Buch liegt auf den Tisch.
erros.certo: Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch.

erros.errado: Ich lege das Buch auf dem Tisch.
erros.certo: Ich lege das Buch auf den Tisch.

blocos.enunciado: Write an e-mail of about 50 words to a friend about your weekend (Perfekt), how you were (Präteritum), and who you helped or gave something to. Then read it out loud.
Write 3 mistakes you still make with the Perfekt and the dative, and the correct form.
